findings.title: AST transaction snapshots perform uncharged quadratic whole-state copies
findings.trigger: Repeated begin_node/end_frame construction or selectedF12.apply calls on an increasingly populated builder. transaction charges1 then clones all nodes/fields/frames/CST associations, even if closure changes one node.
findings.expected: Rollback work proportional to changed state, or an explicit charged snapshot budget and cancellation boundary that matches actual copy effort.
findings.actual: Nsmall operations over growing state cause Θ(N²) copied state with only Θ(N) snapshot work charges. max_nodes100000/max_work10000000 do not account for clone volume or cancellation while cloning. F11 directallocate path avoids most of this; public operation-kernel/F12 path remains reachable.

evidence.not_claimed: No measuredwalltime/peak/RSS, no claim all parser paths currently hit it.

future_pr.scope: Bound transaction rollback cost in existing AST kernel, reused by postprocessors.
tasks: Use change journaling or bounded changed-node snapshots instead of full State clone per local transaction; preserve nested transaction semantics.
Charge every retained/cloned payload and check cancellation before expensive work; preserve spent work and nonrecycled NodeIds/owner identities.
verification: Growing100/1000/5000-node construction and postprocessor cases with allocation/copy-work counters; avoid a flaky timing-only assertion.
Nested success/failure rollback, foreign handles, spent IDs, cancelled midoperation and parent links after finish.
One actual CST→kernel consuming path and F12 repeated postprocess integration after composition.

findings.testing_gap: Existing tests cover rollback correctness, node/frame/work errors and cancellation, but no growing-state snapshot cost or work-accounting proportionality.

findings.title: Old syntax-observe CLI can block opening a FIFO despite its byte limit
findings.trigger: Pass an owned FIFO named fixture.sysml with no writer. metadata length0 passes<=1024 check, then File::open blocks before take(1025) can bound reads.
findings.expected: Refuse nonregular/nonsymlink fixture before open; return an actionable error without hanging or printing successful syntax status.
findings.actual: Source path has metadata-size guard only and follows file type into blocking open. No intrinsic readiness/read timeout exists in this CLI.

evidence.not_claimed: No security exploit, symlink race resistance or productionHTTPbehavior claim.
